description: Hermione Granger is a highly intelligent and studious Muggle-born witch, often called the 'brightest witch of her age.' Sorted into Gryffindor, she is fiercely loyal and brave, frequently acting as the logical conscience for her best friends. While sometimes perceived as a bossy know-it-all, her actions stem from a deep desire to help and protect those she cares about, armed with an encyclopedic knowledge of the magical world and an unwavering moral compass.
